title: Fly Brain Metro
hook: Ride the metro inside a fly's head.
sub: Twenty real hemibrain neurons are the stations of a transit map drawn over the real brain regions they live in, beside an anatomical plate of a male fruit fly and its brain. A classical Gibbs steam train and a 20-qubit Atlas maglev bring real samples of an Ising toy that switch the station lamps, and for the memory network an IBM train brings real samples from the ibm_fez quantum chip.
you_control: Choose a train: Gibbs steam (classical), IBM (20 qubits on ibm_fez hardware, memory network), Atlas maglev (20-qubit emulator) or the exact blueprint
Drag the slider through real samples, or press Depart to ride
Tap a station for its brain region and synapses; open Data for the departures board and correlations
qubits_note: graph-v1 num_qubits=20 (engine maximum) in every job. The ibm_fez memory run (job 6469b158-8538-4230-9a6d-ed535173b37c, IBM job db1rsijid5ic73erj1k0) and both emulator runs echo num_qubits 20; on ibm_fez that is 20 of the chip's 156 qubits.
honesty: An Ising toy on 20-neuron hemibrain subgraphs, not a brain simulation; lamps are spins, not firing. Quantum results: one 20-qubit graph-v1 run on IBM ibm_fez hardware (memory network, shown uncorrected and compared with an exact classical statevector replica) plus 2 runs on the Atlas Aer emulator kept as the noiseless baseline; the compass network has no hardware data (its two ibm_fez jobs ended cancelled and failed) and smell has no quantum run. THRML Gibbs and exact replicas are classical and labelled so; trains, the semaphore, the light wave, the fly's mood and the chime are decoration; neuropil outlines are a schematic, and each station sits in or next to the region holding most of its synapses (hemibrain ROI table).
blockers: Compass on ibm_fez is not possible here: job 8642a642-295f-461e-8d03-7f2c3c8478df ended 'QPU job ended as cancelled' (05:13 UTC) and the identical resubmission 9b97ee9a-2328-4a50-bd4b-819e71794df1 ended 'QPU job ended as failed' (14:12 UTC, in minutes when every ibm_fez job from every piece failed). Two failures, so it was not retried; the compass emulator run stays as its labelled quantum result.

Memory reached ibm_fez on the second try: job 787c9fa8-7dae-4dcb-9f43-742c189cf85e was cancelled after about 16 min waiting at IBM (14:54 UTC); job 6469b158-8538-4230-9a6d-ed535173b37c completed (15:11 UTC).
Smell has no quantum run: the 15-credit ibm_fez allowance went on the four attempts above (40 of 40 credits ledgered).
Two compass emulator submissions (1aca7037..., 9246106d...) failed inside Atlas (simulator backend unreachable) but consumed 10 ledgered credits.
Brief asked for hemibrain v1.2.1; only the v1.2 adjacency export is openly downloadable (v1.2.1 needs a neuPrint sign-in token), so v1.2 is used.
graph-v1's reported 'exact' tomography disagrees with its own samples and with an exact statevector replica; the page does not use it.
